build_NeRF_model: build a NeRF model with configurable depth, hidden units, skip connections, and input channels for neural radiance fields
create_Embedding_module: create a Fourier feature embedding module that maps inputs to sin and cos frequency bands with cosine windowing
build_SE3head_model: build an SE3 head NeRF model that outputs per-point rigid transforms using rotation, pivot, and translation
create_RTHead_model: create an RT head NeRF model that outputs rigid transforms using quaternions or exponential map for rotation
build_FrameCode_module: build a FrameCode module that converts frame and video indices into embedding codes using Fourier features and MLP
